design: rigid fits; Pi retained by lid posts; glue on finger cradle and optional LCD corner pegs

lcd_limitations.electrical: Unpowered mechanical fit only; LCD supply is 3.3 V via d7, GND via d5.
lcd_limitations.contact: High SHIM reference leaves 0.7 mm pin exposed. Measure >=4 mm exposed above physically seated SHIM before plugging sockets on pins 3/5. No reliable electrical contact is claimed by the clearance screen.
